scope: Public site only. Private CRM is out of scope; webhook receiver is treated as an untrusted peer that can fail.
trust_boundaries: internet -> TLS proxy -> loopback HTTP server (only a loopback peer with TRUST_PROXY=1 may state client identity)
public config JSON -> DOM (values are data, never markup or scheme)
server -> delivery child -> receiver (no database, no argv secrets, no redirects, absolute deadline)
CI artifact bytes -> offline verifier (bytes bound to provider digest; producer verdicts ignored)
browser sessionStorage (opaque key and digest only)
browser chat -> signed brief -> browser tab (replay window, no durable chat store)
public support endpoint -> configured model provider (per-turn opt-in)

threats.goal: lose or duplicate an accepted lead
threats.precondition: process death or concurrency at any step of acceptance
threats.control: BEGIN IMMEDIATE, lead+outbox in one commit, unique idempotency index

threats.goal: restore destroys the only good database
threats.precondition: interruption or full disk during restore
threats.control: one atomic rename; preserved copies; sidecars settled first

threats.precondition: attacker rotates identities, forges proxy headers, or a second server splits memory
threats.control: rightmost proxy value only from loopback, IPv6 /64, bounded tiers, single-process guard

threats.precondition: a proxy and this server disagree on message length
threats.control: HTTP/1.0 close-delimited; Transfer-Encoding, duplicate and non-digit Content-Length refused

threats.precondition: victim browser and a CORS-simple content type
threats.control: Origin check plus parsed media type
absolute header and body deadlines, bounded slots

threats.precondition: a hostile value reaches config/business.json or /api/config
threats.control: escaping, https-only parsed URLs, reviewed sink inventory, CSP

threats.goal: signed lead or bot token reaches another host
threats.control: redirects rejected in the child; URL only from deployment environment

threats.precondition: stale commit, swapped artifact, diluted suite, forged PASS
threats.control: provider digest, exact SHA, required test identities, budgets recomputed from raw samples

threats.goal: site process reads secrets elsewhere in the home directory
threats.precondition: code execution inside the site process under the current systemd --user unit
threats.control: NONE EFFECTIVE in user mode (measured); system-manager candidate blocks it (measured)

threats.goal: publish a wrong price, right or legal claim
threats.precondition: unapproved value in catalog or media
threats.control: parity validator detects disagreement only; approval is outside engineering

threats.goal: accepted lead never reaches an operator
threats.precondition: receiver down, misconfigured, or acknowledging without persisting
threats.control: durable outbox, bounded retry, terminal state, readiness never claims receiver truth

threats.goal: turn a support conversation into a lead without user action
threats.precondition: visitor starts a quote or reviews a draft
threats.control: support reply only returns a draft; sending requires submitting the separate lead form

threats.goal: inject a false commitment or change a signed brief
threats.precondition: client tampers with state or provider feedback claims price, booking, or scheduling
threats.control: signed expiring state, model prose discarded, contextual offer derives from caller intent and reconciled facts

threats.goal: trigger third-party processing through an ambiguous support request
threats.precondition: cross-site client, duplicate consent, or attachment without per-turn opt-in
threats.control: same-origin POST, reject duplicate keys, explicit consent with provider enabled, redact contact patterns before forwarding text
